row.notes: Handler for reset/pit state 0 in the switch of Game_Pitlane_ApplyVehicleResetState (cases 0-5 call 0x1434c0600/0x1434c0fb0/0x1434c1c00/0x1434c2870/0x1434c3520/0x1434c1780). Computes the vehicle placement transform with Sess_VehiclePlacement_ResolveTransform for slot index param_4 (special slot 0xc via ctx+0x738, <0x20 via ctx+0x838+8*slot) and memcpys the result. 2470 bytes. Also called by Game_PitLane_HandleEnterPitBox (0x1434b8028). Hypothesis on the meaning of state 0. | engine-re 2026-11-17 track round C2 (static): per-car pit SPLINE builder, not a placement resolver: writes knots into the spline passed as arg 2 (car record +0x118 from Game_PitLane_HandleEnterPitBox 0x1434b8028) and finalises it with Ne_Spline_ComputeLengths (0x1434c0f36). Box ENTRY 'pull in through the preceding box' (logs ePullThroughPrecedingPit / handleEnterPitBoxPullInThroughPrecedingBox): car pose -> neighbour box (box + (mgr+0xc2a ? -1 : +1)) -> own box point (box record mgr+0x40+box*0x90, +0x30), offsets via 0x1434c6e00 scaled by box_entry_normal_interpolatation_first/second/third (mgr+0x8c8/+0x8d0/+0x8d8).
